notes: S6/§11.5: the container has `previous_manifest: null`, but the caller supplies a previous container. A supplied --previous requires a non-null chain whose digest matches, so this is E_MANIFEST_CHAIN invalid (this is how a receiver detects a silently restarted chain). The previous-manifest chain is container step (10), after the record phase, so the container's record has already been processed and is reported valid; the invalid container error does not erase its verdict.
